title: Comment Thread
content: Create comment thread component. Structure: parent comment with nested replies. Avatar: user avatar and name. Timestamp: relative time display. Content: comment text with markdown support. Actions: reply, edit, delete, like. Threading: indent nested replies with connecting line. Collapse: collapse/expand reply chains. Pagination: load more for many comments. Composer: inline reply input field. Highlighting: highlight new or mentioned comments. Sort: newest first, oldest first, top comments.

variants.simple: Build threaded comment display with replies.
variants.detailed: Create comment thread component. Structure: parent comment with nested replies. Avatar: user avatar and name. Timestamp: relative time display. Content: comment text with markdown support. Actions: reply, edit, delete, like. Threading: indent nested replies with connecting line. Collapse: collapse/expand reply chains. Pagination: load more for many comments. Composer: inline reply input field. Highlighting: highlight new or mentioned comments. Sort: newest first, oldest first, top comments.
variants.advanced: Create comprehensive threaded comment system with full interactions. Comment structure: avatar, author name, timestamp, content, action buttons, nested replies array. Metadata display: author with optional badge (admin, OP), relative timestamp ("2 hours ago") with tooltip for exact time. Content rendering: markdown support for formatting, @mentions highlighted and linked, links clickable, code formatting. Actions: reply (opens inline composer), edit (for own comments, inline editor), delete (with confirmation, shows "[deleted]"), like/upvote (count + filled state), report/flag, share/copy link. Threading: nested replies indented (ml-8 or ml-12), vertical line connector (border-l-2 from parent), max depth limit (3-4 levels) then flatten with "View more replies". Collapse/expand: collapse long threads with "Show 12 more replies", expand inline, remember state. Pagination: initial comment count (20), "Load more comments" button or infinite scroll, load more per thread. Reply composer: inline text area below comment when "Reply" clicked, cancel/submit buttons, user avatar preview. Highlighting: new comments (bg-blue-50 briefly), mentioned user view. Sorting: newest, oldest, top (by likes), toggle in header. Loading states: skeleton for initial load, inline spinner for loading more. Deleted/hidden: "[deleted]" for removed comments preserving thread structure. Edit history: "edited" badge with optional view edits.
